corrections.text: The article states the memory shortage 'pushed the figure roughly 30 percent higher.' The increase from Valve's stated $750 target to the $1,049 base price is about 40 percent, and no cited source states a 30 percent figure.

The article attributes the memory shortage being 'driven largely by AI data-center demand' to XDA Developers. The cited XDA article attributes the price rise to the RAM market generally and does not mention AI or data centers. The AI/data-center causation is supported by GamersNexus, which reports that memory priority went to 'NVIDIA, OpenAI, and other hyperscalers and data center companies.'

The article states the console 'runs SteamOS, the same Linux-based operating system as the Steam Deck, according to Engadget.' The cited Engadget article does not use the terms 'SteamOS' or 'Linux'; the SteamOS detail is confirmed by GamersNexus. The fact itself is accurate.
